Name: Riazaia's Boar for CP
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]I loved Riazaia's Boar and they were kind enough to allow me to turn it into a custom barn animal!
You can find the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2113]HERE[/url]﻿! It turns the Travelling Cart into a nice rustic version.


[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Download the mod and unzip it into your mods folder.



[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]

- Purchase a Boar at Marnie's for 20000g
- Will find white truffles[/center]

Downloads.Description: Fixed the animals getting stuck and not going back inside at night
